messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
river_cruise | Singapore River Cruise | 28 | 40 | 09:00-22:30 | -
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
skypark | Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck | 32 | 60 | 11:00-21:00 | -
haw_par_villa | Haw Par Villa | 0 | 90 | 09:00-20:00 | -
wings_of_time | Wings of Time | 19 | 20 | 19:30-21:30 | 19:40, 20:40
singapore_zoo | Singapore Zoo | 49 | 240 | 08:30-18:00 | -
singapore_flyer | Singapore Flyer | 40 | 45 | 10:00-22:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
river_cruise: peranakan_museum 12, skypark 15, haw_par_villa 28, wings_of_time 23, singapore_zoo 44, singapore_flyer 15, national_gallery 12
peranakan_museum: river_cruise 12, skypark 15, haw_par_villa 29, wings_of_time 25, singapore_zoo 43, singapore_flyer 15, national_gallery 12
skypark: river_cruise 15, peranakan_museum 15, haw_par_villa 31, wings_of_time 25, singapore_zoo 47, singapore_flyer 12, national_gallery 14
haw_par_villa: river_cruise 28, peranakan_museum 29, skypark 31, wings_of_time 23, singapore_zoo 43, singapore_flyer 32, national_gallery 29
wings_of_time: river_cruise 23, peranakan_museum 25, skypark 25, haw_par_villa 23, singapore_zoo 52, singapore_flyer 26, national_gallery 24
singapore_zoo: river_cruise 44, peranakan_museum 43, skypark 47, haw_par_villa 43, wings_of_time 52, singapore_flyer 46, national_gallery 45
singapore_flyer: river_cruise 15, peranakan_museum 15, skypark 12, haw_par_villa 32, wings_of_time 26, singapore_zoo 46, national_gallery 14
national_gallery: river_cruise 12, peranakan_museum 12, skypark 14, haw_par_villa 29, wings_of_time 24, singapore_zoo 45, singapore_flyer 14

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

I'm free from 10:00 to 22:15. Money is not a concern. I want to visit Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck, Haw Par Villa, Singapore Flyer and National Gallery Singapore. If there's time, I'd also like Singapore River Cruise, Peranakan Museum, Wings of Time and Singapore Zoo. I'd like to spend 120 minutes at Haw Par Villa.
